definitions.explanation: The natural process of getting older over time. Used especially in medical, health, and scientific contexts to describe age-related changes, as opposed to {老化|ろうか} which emphasizes deterioration.

examples.japanese: {加齢|かれい}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
{加齢|かれい}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm concerned about age-related changes in my skin.

examples.japanese: {加齢|かれい}{臭|しゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Measures to prevent body odor from aging are gaining popularity.

notes:
A neutral, somewhat clinical term for aging. Compared to ⟦{老化|ろうか}→老化：13905_rouka⟧ (deterioration due to aging), {加齢|かれい} simply describes the passage of years without the negative connotation of decline. Frequently used in health and beauty product marketing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {加齢|かれい}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧ — with aging, as one gets older
- {加齢|かれい}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧ — caused by aging, age-related
- {加齢|かれい}{臭|しゅう} — body odor associated with aging
- {加齢|かれい}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧ — age-related phenomenon
- {加齢|かれい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ — anti-aging measures
